description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidPsiElementFinder, which extends PsiElementFinder. It provides mechanisms to locate and manage Android-specific PSI classes, particularly the internal R class, within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

classes.name: AndroidPsiElementFinder
classes.description: A class extending PsiElementFinder to locate Android internal R classes within a project, managing internal class references and providing class search functionalities.

methods.name: AndroidPsiElementFinder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the finder and subscribes to JDK table changes.

methods.name: processInternalRClasses
methods.description: Processes internal R classes across modules within a given scope, applying a processor to each.

methods.name: findClass
methods.description: Finds a class by qualified name within a scope, returning the first match.

methods.name: getOrCreateInternalRClass
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the internal R class for a given SDK and platform, with thread safety.

methods.name: findClasses
methods.description: Finds all classes matching a qualified name within a scope, with special handling for internal R classes.

methods.name: getClassNames
methods.description: Returns class names available in a package, specifically 'R' for the internal package.
